title: Deterministic Proper Positive-Only Learning Is Independent of ZFC
abstract: arXiv:2611.29737v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Binary classification from positive-only samples is a variant of PAC learning in which the learner receives i.i.d. samples only from the positive region of an unknown target concept, but is evaluated on the full distribution. Improper learnability in this model has a textbook characterization, whereas proper learnability has remained open for decades. Recent work characterized it for learners with access to randomness, and showed that, unlike in PAC learning, some classes are properly learnable with randomness but not without it, leaving the deterministic case open. We show that this case cannot be resolved within the standard axioms of mathematics (ZFC): there is a class of VC dimension two whose deterministic proper learnability is independent of ZFC, even though a randomized learner provably learns it. translated_title: 确定性proper纯正样本学习独立于ZFC公理体系
translated_abstract: 仅从正样本进行二元分类是PAC学习的一种变体，其中学习者只从未知目标概念的正区域获得独立同分布的样本，但其在完整分布上接受评估。在该模型中，非proper可学习性已有教科书式的刻画，而proper可学习性数十年来一直悬而未决。最近的工作刻画了可使用随机性的学习者的proper可学习性，并表明与PAC学习不同，某些类在使用随机性时是proper可学习的，而在没有随机性时则不然，这使得确定性情形仍然悬而未决。我们证明这一情形无法在数学的标准公理体系（ZFC）内得到解决：存在一个VC维为2的类，其确定性proper可学习性独立于ZFC，尽管可以证明随机化学习者能够学习它。此外，没有任何具有有限特征的维数——这是学习理论中大多数维数共有的理想性质——能够刻画确定性的proper可学习性。
tldr: 本文证明存在一个VC维为2的概念类，尽管随机化学习者能够学习它，但其确定性proper纯正样本可学习性无法在ZFC公理体系内判定，即独立于ZFC。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that there exists a concept class of VC dimension two whose deterministic proper positive-only learnability is independent of ZFC, even though a randomized learner provably learns it.
